sentences.text:
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.1199/2022 registered at Police Station-Nishatpura,
District-Bhopal (MP) for the offence under Sections 419, 420, 120-B of the IPC and later on Sections 467, 468, 471, 201 of the IPC were added.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the bail application.
4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

sentences.text: As per prosecution story, Imran and Zohar had introduced Sanjay and Wasim to complainant Iqbal and Affaq.
Sanjay and Wasim represented to complainant Iqbal and Affaq that they will get them a clear title plot for construction.
Believing them, complainant Iqbal and Affaq paid amount to Sanjay Singh.
Later on, money was also paid to Wasim for getting possession of the plot in question.
Sanjay and Wasim both acted as middle men.
Later, it is found that plot which was registered in their name was sold to them on basis of forged document.
3. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, it is found that offence committed by applicant is serious in nature, bail application filed by applicant, is dismissed.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE shabana Date: 2023.10.19 13:11:22 +05'30'
